name: io.github.cmendezs/mcp-ksef-pl
description: MCP server for Polish electronic invoicing: KSeF API v2 (FA(3) format), FA(2) validation, and Peppol/EN 16931 UBL. Generates, validates, parses, and submits e-invoices to the Polish KSeF platform with AES-256 encrypted session-based submission.

tools.name: generate_fa3_invoice
tools.description: Generate a KSeF FA(3) XML invoice for submission via KSeF API v2. FA(3) is required for all new submissions; use this before calling submit_invoice_to_ksef.

tools.name: generate_fa2_invoice
tools.description: Generate a KSeF FA(2) XML invoice (legacy format). Use for validation and parsing workflows; KSeF API v2 requires FA(3) for new submissions.

tools.name: validate_fa2_invoice
tools.description: Validate a KSeF FA(2) XML invoice against the official XSD schema and business rules.

tools.name: parse_fa2_invoice
tools.description: Parse a KSeF FA(2) XML invoice into a structured dictionary.

tools.name: submit_invoice_to_ksef
tools.description: Submit a FA(3) XML invoice to KSeF API v2 using AES-256-CBC encrypted session-based submission. Returns session and invoice reference numbers.

tools.name: get_ksef_invoice_status
tools.description: Retrieve the processing status of a submitted KSeF invoice using the compound reference number returned by submit_invoice_to_ksef.

tools.name: search_ksef_invoices
tools.description: Query invoices stored in KSeF using date range and other filters.

tools.name: validate_polish_nip
tools.description: Validate a Polish NIP (tax identification number) using the official checksum algorithm.

tools.name: validate_polish_regon
tools.description: Validate a Polish REGON (business registry number) — 9 or 14 digits.

tools.name: generate_peppol_invoice
tools.description: Generate a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL 2.1 XML invoice (EN 16931 compliant) for cross-border B2B trade.
